question: Fast pass, slow fund: what challenge-phase risk gets a funded account fastest and cheapest (counting retries), within every rule, and does our edge beat a no-edge gamble?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-03 before any v4 simulation. Rule-breaking schemes (cross-account or cross-firm opposite positions, reverse copy trading) are excluded: they are banned and void payouts. Same rule snapshot, universes, buffer, caps and simulator as v3; the funded phase always uses the best v3 funded policy (0.5x with headroom scaling). Historical seen data: descriptive; both samples must agree.

challenge_policies.blend_hr: multi-premia blend on the firm universe, challenge scale in [1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0], headroom scaling and daily vol guard on
challenge_policies.gamble_btc: no-edge reference: long BTC at challenge scale in [1.0, 2.0, 3.0], headroom scaling and vol guard on; funded phase not evaluated (a gamble has no funded edge)

retry_model: attempts are bought one after another until a pass; with pass probability p and mean attempt length D (passes and failures), expected fees to a funded account = fee / p and expected days = D / p
choice_rule: per firm, the blend challenge scale with the lowest expected_days_to_funded among those whose net_value_12m is positive on both samples and whose funded_survival_12m >= 0.7 on both; ties by net value
